terms.comment: A term of the later grammarians. Verba impersōnālia, impersonal verbs, such as pluit, licet.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 332.
